errors.certificateTitle: Windows could not verify the download certificate
errors.certificateSummary: WeekBox was blocked by Windows before the download started. Check your date and time, then try another network. A VPN, proxy, or antivirus HTTPS scanning can also block the certificate check.
errors.oneDriveSummary: WeekBox cannot safely download engines into OneDrive. Use a local folder such as C:\WeekBox instead.
errors.writeFolderTitle: WeekBox cannot write to this folder
errors.writeFolderSummary: Check that your storage folder is local, writable, and not being used by another program.
errors.storageDriveTitle: WeekBox cannot access the storage drive
errors.storageDriveSummary: The folder containing this engine is unavailable or cannot be read. Check that the selected drive is connected and writable.
errors.downloadUnavailableTitle: This download is no longer available
errors.downloadUnavailableSummary: The selected engine file could not be downloaded. Try another version or try again later.
errors.quotaExceededSummary: This file has exceeded its download quota on the host server (Google Drive) because too many users downloaded it recently. Try another download link or try again later.
errors.invalidLinkTitle: This download link is not usable
errors.invalidLinkSummary: The mod page does not provide a direct file link. Choose another download or ask the mod author to replace the link.
errors.unpackTitle: WeekBox could not unpack the download
errors.unpackSummary: The downloaded file may be incomplete or invalid. Retry the download with a local storage folder.
errors.emptyDownloadTitle: This download has no files to install
errors.emptyDownloadSummary: The download source provided an empty package. Nothing was installed. Try another download option or come back later; if it keeps happening, the upload needs to be fixed by its author.
errors.invalidMacInstallerTitle: The macOS installer contains no app
errors.invalidMacInstallerSummary: WeekBox mounted the downloaded disk image but could not find an application inside it. Try another version or report this release to the engine author.
errors.notZipTitle: The download was not a ZIP file
errors.notZipSummary: The download source returned something other than the expected archive, often an expired link or a server error page. WeekBox kept it from being installed. Try again later or choose another version.
errors.unsupportedBuildTitle: This engine build is not supported
errors.unsupportedBuildSummary: The download finished, but WeekBox could not find a runnable {{os}} app file. Copy the report so we can investigate this version.
errors.unexpectedSummary: WeekBox could not finish this action. Copy the error report if you need help.
